records.title: JASSO Student Exchange Support Program
records.deadline_display: Applications for the scholarship will be accepted only from Japanese school.

source.raw_extract:
The Whole Process





Applications for the scholarship will be accepted only from Japanese school.
Upon screening the application documents submitted by Japanese school, JASSO will decide the programs to support and notice the results.
The selection method of scholarship recipients is different from each school and each program. For further information and inquiry, students are advised to ask each home school.


Starting Time of Scholarship Period


Students must start the study-in-Japan program at Japanese schools during each school's designated period.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications for the scholarship will be accepted only from Japanese school.
source.notes: No date, month or window is published. Applications originate from the Japanese host school under a bilateral exchange agreement, and JASSO explicitly directs all timing questions to each home school. The only published timing statement is tied to the host school's designated study period, which is institution-specific and cannot be turned into a calendar date.

source.notes: Two official York pages give different calendar days for the SAME PISE student application deadline in the SAME upcoming cycle (Fall/Winter 2026-2027 entry = Fall 2027), and the nomination deadline matches on both (February 4, 2027), so these are the same deadline and not two different programmes. Per brief section 6, a genuine disagreement between credible sources about the same deadline is recorded as CONFLICTING with deadline_date null and precision 'varies'. Both candidate values are preserved verbatim above for human review; neither was adopted.

records.title: Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP) - Ph.D. Scholarship and Stipend, Academia Sinica
records.deadline_display: The TIGP Admission Office receives on-line applications from November 1st to February 1st every year.

source.publisher: Academia Sinica - Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP)
source.as_of: Recurring annual window; most recent posted cycle announcement is 'TIGP Application Announcement for 2026' published 2025-11-01 with 'before 1 February 2026 (GMT+8)', which has passed
source.raw_extract:
General Information

The TIGP Admission Office receives on-line applications from November 1st to February 1st every year. Results of admissions are usually announced in late June / early July; admitted applicants may be enrolled in the following fall semester.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The TIGP Admission Office receives on-line applications from November 1st to February 1st every year.
source.notes: The official TIGP programme page states a recurring annual window and no fixed current date. Checked the live News & Announcement index (https://tigp.sinica.edu.tw/pages/2748): the newest application announcement is 'TIGP Application Announcement for 2026' dated 2025-11-01 ('before 1 February 2026 (GMT+8)' - already past) and the newest item overall is 'The Announcement of 2026 TIGP Admissions' dated 2026-07-20. As of retrieval on 2026-10-05 no 2027-cycle announcement with a current calendar deadline has been posted, so per brief section 6 the recurring window is recorded as ANNUAL/recurring with deadline_date null and was NOT converted into a date. Note the stipend itself (TIGP Scholarship/Stipend) is awarded on admission, so the admissions window above is the only application timing the official programme publishes for this award.

rejected_sources.reason: The only explicit calendar deadline on this page ('before 1 February 2026 (GMT+8)') belongs to the closed 2026 cycle; it was not reused as the current deadline and not rolled forward to 2027.

source.raw_extract:
PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT
KINGDOM OF MOROCCO –  GOVERNMENT OF RWANDA SCHOLARSHIPS.
The Higher Education Council (HEC) wishes to inform the general public that the Kingdom of Morocco has offered to the Government of Rwanda scholarships at Diploma, Bachelors, Masters and PhD  level commencing in academic year 2026/2027 taught in French from Moroccan public training institutions/ universities.
...
Application deadline:  29/08/2026
Done at  Kigali, 26/08/2026

 
Dr. Edward KADOZI
Director General
source.notes: The PDF on the shard's official_source_url was fetched live and its text extracted from the document itself. It gives one explicit calendar deadline, 29 August 2026 for the 2026/2027 cycle. That date fell about five weeks before the retrieval date of 2026-10-05 and the 2026/2027 call is closed, while the record is open/upcoming, so per brief section 6 the stale date is NOT written to deadline_date and is NOT silently moved to the next cycle. The live HEC scholarships index (https://www.hec.gov.rw/updates/scholarships) shows the Morocco call dated Wednesday, 26 August 2026 and, above it, only newer unrelated items ('CALL FOR APPLICATIONS FOR GOVERNMENT STUDY LOAN – JANUARY 2027 INTAKE', 02 October 2026; 'PEOPLE'S DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF ALGERIA – RWANDA GOVERNMENT SCHOLARSHIPS', 24 September 2026), so no newer 2027/2028 Morocco call exists to recover. The published date is preserved in published_deadline_iso for traceability only. This matches the shard's own verification_status of needs_review.
